selected.rationale: Every recipe repeats the same Problem, Solution, Discussion and See Also frame (outline levels 2-3, for example 6.1 Integer Numbers). The Solution shows each regex in several language flavours. This gives a fixed, reader-goal-driven structure that the other two books do not have.
